title: fumaria numidica var. reboudiana
intro: Fumaria numidica var. reboudiana, commonly known as Fumaria reboudiana, is a plant species belonging to the fumitory family (Fumariaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cold, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria reboudiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. The exact bioactive constituents of Fumaria reboudiana have not been extensively studied, but it is believed to contain various alkaloids, including fumarine and fumaramine.
